title: Recipe import
description: The small import format a language model of the user's choice writes from a recipe (decision ai-prompt-import): names and amounts as written, no ids. A recipe is components with lines, optionally slots of a dish with alternatives. Culina matches the names with the user's confirmation; nothing here is stored as it stands.

recipes.description: One entry per recipe of the answer.

amount.description: An amount as the recipe writes it, number first, then the unit word: 200 g, 1/2 TL, 3.

slotRole.description: The role of a component or a slot in a dish: the dish roles Culina offers.

lineRole.description: The role of an ingredient in its component: the roles of Culina's ratio cards and dishes.

title.description: The recipe's name as the recipe gives it.

persons.description: How many persons or portions the recipe states.

yield.description: What the recipe states it makes, when it gives no persons: 1 kg, 12 pieces.

components.description: The parts made separately (dough, sauce); a simple recipe has one.

slots.description: The dish: what fills each role, by name. Left out, every component is one slot.

steps.description: The assembly: what is done once the components are made.

source.description: Where the recipe is from; at least one field.

title.description: Title of the book, site or card.

author.description: Author as named in the source.

url.description: Address of the page, when the recipe is from the web.

where.description: Where in the source: page, chapter, section.

name.description: The component's name, unique in its recipe.

role.description: Its role in the dish, when no slot names it.

lines.description: The ingredients, in the recipe's order.

steps.description: The steps of this component, in order, each in its own entry.

ingredient.description: The ingredient's name as written, without amount and preparation.

amount.description: The amount as written; left out when the recipe gives none.

guessed.description: True when the recipe states no such amount and it was guessed.

role.description: The ingredient's role, where one fits.

note.description: The preparation as written: finely chopped, melted.

component.description: The name of the component that fills it.

ingredient.description: Or the name of an ingredient that fills it as it is (bread, rice).

amount.description: The amount of an ingredient filling as written, per dish; a component fills its slot with its whole run.

guessed.description: True when that amount was guessed.

optional.description: True when the recipe says the filling may be left out.

alternatives.description: Names of other components of this recipe that may fill the slot instead.
